title: Synthetic Voices, Real Threats: Evaluating Large Text-to-Speech Models in Generating Harmful Audio
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. Its focus is on the generation of generally harmful or toxic audio content.
findings: The paper's analysis does not include religion; therefore, there are no findings related to it.
